summary.text: Gary Gates is a Republican member of the Texas House of Representatives who has represented District 28 since February 11, 2020 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Gary Gates' current term ends on January 12, 2027.

According to a Ballotpedia excerpt of his campaign website, his priorities include reforming the property appraisal process and banning a state income tax, supporting public schools and parental choice, emergency preparedness, border security, and opposing abortion.
